title: One stop shop, Amazing!
body:
I really like the idea that I can track my habits, Set a non distracting timer and breaks also journal my thoughts on one app! Kudos on that👊🏾

One thing that could be managed better is the information hierarchy when the already set habit is clicked. Things are a bit random there, and some other areas.

An improvement in UI would make this app a top notch tool.
author: Vooh65
